title: Baby Model Rewind
description: Restores the old baby mob look in 26.1+: scaled-down adult models instead of the redesigned Tiny Takeover baby models. No dependencies required.
body:
## Baby Model Rewind

### What's new in v1.0.0 for 26.2
- Now available for Minecraft 26.2 (Fabric and NeoForge)

The **26.1 Tiny Takeover** update gave every baby mob a unique model with new proportions. This mod reverts that — baby mobs are rendered as scaled-down adult models again, exactly like they were before 26.1.

### What it changes
- All ageable baby mobs use the adult model at **0.5× scale** instead of their new Tiny Takeover models
- Adult textures are used so UV mapping is correct
- Covers all vanilla baby mobs: cows, pigs, sheep, chickens, wolves, cats, horses, zombies, husks, drowned, piglins, zombified piglins, villagers, zombie villagers, striders, hoglins, and more

### Notes
- **Client-side only** — works on any server, no server mod needed
- **No dependencies** — only requires Fabric Loader
- Compatible with shader packs and most other rendering mods
